name: Drowned Herdsman
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Never Rides Alone
Traits.text: While the Herdsman is not Incapacitated, the Herdsman has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if a drowned horse bound to it is within 5 feet of that creature and not Incapacitated.

Traits.name: Whistling up the Herd
Traits.text: While the Herdsman is not Incapacitated and a body of water or flooded ground lies within 60 feet, the Herdsman summons a drowned horse from the water, which rises at the start of its next turn and serves it; no more than three steeds are bound to it at once, and a slain steed must sink and the silt settle before another can be called.
Traits.clause: So long as it is not Incapacitated, the herdsman can call a drowned horse from any body of water or flooded ground withi
Traits.expresses: whistling up a herd of drowned horses
Traits.expressedQuote: the Herdsman summons a drowned horse from the water, which rises at the start of its next turn and serves it

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the herdsman, the herdsman and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the herdsman doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The herdsman makes three attacks, using Crook or Drowned Hoof in any combination.

Actions.name: Crook
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Drowned Hoof
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Gurgling Command (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: Each ally within 30 feet of the herdsman gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points.
Bonus Actions.gmQuote: a shepherd of drowned horses who never fights alone

lore: Once a river-herder who drowned with every horse in his charge, he whistles drowned beasts up from the silt so his herd is never empty again.

generation.userConcept: a shepherd of drowned horses who never fights alone

monsterDescription: a shepherd of drowned horses who never fights alone
